summary: Phase 3 Night Finder - Notification enrichment + push on like/comment + /users/search endpoint + frontend /search screen. Backend: 12/12 pytest PASS (test_phase3_search_and_notif_enrichment.py). Enrichment verified via JWT-impersonation of bot owner: GET /api/notifications returns synthesized 'ActorName a aime ton moment coeur' + body for moment_like, and 'ActorName a commente ton moment 'speech' + text_preview for moment_comment. Legacy notifs (checkin/event/promo/nearby) keep their original title/body untouched. Push service silent-fail confirmed: POST /moments/{id}/like and /comments both return 200 even when push_service may error. /api/users/search: q<2 returns empty, q='chlo' returns 2 Chloe bots case-insensitively, admin/hidden/private/caller excluded, payload includes user_id/name/age/city/picture/bio/is_premium/is_bot, 401 without auth. Frontend E2E (mobile viewport 375x667): admin login -> /feed shows feed-search icon in header -> tap navigates to /search -> autofocus input with placeholder 'Nom ou prenom...' -> typing 'chlo' returns 2 users live-debounced -> tap on user navigates to /story-viewer?user_id=X&user_name=Chloe -> story viewer renders correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 3942 lines. Splitting into feature modules (auth, moments, notifications, swipe, admin, search) is now a strong recommendation for maintainability.
GET /api/notifications still returns a raw list while other endpoints (moments/feed, moments/highlights, users/search) return {items|users|moments, count}. Consistency would help clients.
The regex in /users/search escapes special chars manually via a comprehension - fine, but re.escape() would be more idiomatic and safer.

notification_id key is inconsistent across the codebase: moment_like/moment_comment use 'notification_id' but older code paths (match_request, match_accepted, checkin) use 'notif_id'. Consider standardising on one.

search.tsx pushes to /story-viewer even for users who may have NO active moments. When that happens the story-viewer will show an empty state. Consider showing a subtle indicator in search results for users without active stories.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing 20 seeded bots (2 Chloe) and 8 seeded moments.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL) in /app/frontend/.env - always load that when scripting tests. Admin JWT impersonation trick: sign a JWT with JWT_SECRET (default 'night-finder-dev-secret-change-me') and user_id set to any bot user_id to read that bot's notifications - useful because bots have '!bot-disabled!' password_hash and cannot login normally. Frontend Feed header exposes testID='feed-search'. /search screen exposes testID='search-input' with placeholder 'Nom ou prenom...' and testID='search-user-<user_id>' per row. Live-debounced 250ms. Story-viewer route accepts user_id + user_name params. Notification enrichment happens ONLY at GET /api/notifications read-time (title/body added in the loop) so DB rows for moment_like/moment_comment do NOT contain title/body columns.
rca_of_issue: N/A - all Phase 3 features working as specified.
